title: SuperMóvil
meta_description: Mobile Santander, authorizes your operations easily, quickly and safely.
full_description: With SuperMóvil carry your money and your finances safely, on your cell phone. Make payments, transfers, download the Account Statements of your cards, manage your balance and check the movements of your accounts, request explanations of charges and much more. Santander's digital banking is being renewed.Santander Mexico offers the Digital Banking service through mobile devices to its customers Individuals or Individuals with Business Activity.This application is available in Spanish for smartphones with Android version 6.0 or later. As well as the following functionalities:* Consultation of balances and movements of checking accounts and investments.* Consultation of deposits and withdrawals.* Consultation of comprehensive account statements (checking accounts and credit cards).* Sending Transfers to Other Banks (SPEI) with a schedule of 24 hours, 365 days a year.* Configuration of maximum limits of personal amounts for payments and transfers to Third Parties.* Transfers between own accounts, to third parties, same bank, to other banks.* Check status of transfers to Other Banks (SPEI) sent and received.* Payment of Credit Cards, own, third parties in Santander and other banks.* Payroll portability process to Santander (Bring the payroll) as well as the status query of the portability request.* Payment and Direct Debit of services (Telmex, Telcel, SKY, CFE and more) charged to your Santander accounts and/or credit cards.* Access to the application through your fingerprint, with the possibility of remembering the data.* Generation of cash withdrawal references without a card.* Activation of credit and debit card.* Registration and Cancellation of Third Party Checking Accounts, Third Party Credit Cards and Services from Third Party Account Management.* "My goals" program for intelligent savings: deposits/withdrawals, administration, consultation of movements and balances.* Consultation of account details: account, card and associated telephone number, validity and aliases.* Check card details: cut-off date, payment deadline, minimum payment, payment not to generate interest, credit limit, cut-off balance and express line balance.* Registration, consultation and clarification procedure for unrecognized purchases with credit and debit cards in stores.* Airtime refills.* Availability of CoDi for payments and collections from cell phones.* Check the balance of your personal and mortgage loans.* Consultation of Own and Third Party accounts from Administration of my accounts.* Consult and obtain receipts from the Operations Log.* Consultation of reference status of cash withdrawal without card.* My Finances: tool that helps to know spending habits; available in each checking account and/or credit card.* Configuration: Change of access password, update of personal data, access method (fingerprint), SuperMóvil temporary lock, Mobile Banking, terms and conditions, SuperMóvil cancellation.* Associate and modify your account to a mobile number.* Change of account aliases.* Password unlock.* Management of traditional term investments (payroll and digital).* Deposits, withdrawals and consultation of balances of Growing Money and Term Investments from 10,000 MXN and Payroll Promissory Note from 5,000.00 MXN.* Request for payment of expenses.* Security check operations.* Usage tutorials (general use of the application and use of SuperToken and dynamic PIN) and SuperLínea contact and social networks.* Location of Branches and ATMs.
